# ALNA Systems

> ALNA develops organisational diagnosis and process improvement software for care, rehabilitation and social care organisations. The system is in development. Hebrew and English information are available.

## Product scope

The initial stage focuses on one defined process: mapping the organisational context, connecting existing documents, operational data and staff questionnaire perspectives, examining possible explanations, and developing reasoned options for action. Outputs undergo professional review. Findings, hypotheses and missing information are distinguished.

Subsequent implementation, measurement and learning cycles are a separate continuation under development, agreed explicitly. The aim is to update the map using observed changes; causal impact is not assumed. Example reports contain fictional data and are not client outcomes.
